description: Net (take-home) pay after income tax and employee social security for a gross salary, with a line-by-line breakdown, using official rates for the current tax year. Countries: sg, fr, nl, es, de, us, uk, au, nz, ca, ie, in (41 countries with official tax tables; 12 with take-home pay calculations; 11 with employer cost; 12 in the cross-country comparison (France: take-home pay and compare only, no employer cost yet).) region is REQUIRED for: us, ca; optional for: es, de, uk, in; a missing or unknown region returns the valid codes. Returns the tax year, official source URLs and the calcbloc.com page. Not yet supported: equity compensation (RSUs, stock options), bonus and supplemental withholding, and cross-border (multi-country) withholding.

country.description: Country short code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 in lower case; the UK is "uk", "gb" also works), e.g. "us", "uk", "ca", "de", "in", "au", "nz", or the English name. Older keys such as "new-zealand" also work. See list_countries.

gross_salary.description: Gross salary before tax in the country's currency. Annual for every country except Singapore (monthly); India: annual CTC/gross as described by list_countries.

options.description: Country-specific options. Examples: US {"filing_status":"mfj","children":2} (filing_status: single | mfj | hoh; "married" and "head_of_household" are accepted too), UK {"pension_pct":5,"student_loan":"plan2"} (student_loan: none | plan1 | plan2 | plan4 | plan5), Germany {"tax_class":3,"church":true}. Call list_countries with the country to see every option, its allowed values and its default.

region.description: Region code or name. Required for: us, ca. Examples: US "ca" or "California", UK "scotland", Canada "on", Spain "md", Germany "by". list_countries with the country lists every code.

year.description: Tax year, e.g. "2026" or "2026-27". Default: the current year. Calculations use the current year only.

name: calculate_take_home_pay

attribution.description: Always "Data by CalcBloc"; show it with the figures.

calcblocUrl.description: The calcbloc.com page for this result.

effectiveRate.description: Share of gross pay deducted, 0 to 1.

sources.description: Official sources for the rates used.

retrievedAt.description: Date CalcBloc last checked the source.
